notes: DUPLICATE DEATH YEAR FLAGGED (research 2026-07-03): this Robert Banks's death year (1823) is identical to his son Robert Banks's (I182381536974) tree-recorded death year, and to his son's wife Mary McKie's independently-attested 1823 death (islandregister.com/banks1.html) — the source found does not corroborate an 1823 death for either Robert Banks himself. Two men of the same name, one generation apart, both dying '1823' is a likely duplicate/copy-merge artifact, not a documented coincidence; treat this date as unverified. This man's own parentage ('Robert Banks & Marion Moir', gen 9) and the tree's claimed Scottish gentry ancestry above it (gens 10–12) have no corroborating record of any kind found in this research and should be treated as unsupported/likely tree lore pending a Kelton OPR or ScotlandsPeople search.
